items.title: Target runtime reproduces or rules out the missing border
items.precondition: A signed-in target build and a conversation with at least one unsent message are available.
steps: Open the conversation on the target branch/build.
Locate an own and, when available, a peer unsent-message placeholder.
Compare the visible outline and computed border to the supplied reference image.
items.expected: The runtime state is conclusively documented: either the rounded dashed border is present, or its absence is reproduced on the stated build.
items.evidence: 2026-08-26: User verified on the local server that dark mode shows the dashed outline but light mode renders it too close to white to see.
items.notes: This changes the implementation from restoring a missing border to correcting its light-mode contrast.

items.title: Unsent placeholders retain the requested dashed border
items.precondition: T1 has identified the exact target runtime; any necessary source correction is deployed locally.
steps: Open a default-theme conversation with unsent messages from each participant when available.
Check desktop and a narrow/mobile viewport.
Confirm the outline is rounded and dashed, with transparent fill, muted italic label, and no toolbar or timestamp.
items.expected: Every unsent placeholder matches the reference treatment while normal sent bubbles remain unchanged.
items.evidence: 2026-08-26: Replaced the Tailwind border-color utility with the unlayered .message-bubble-unsent rule, which emits border-color:var(--unsent-message-border) and wins over the app-wide universal border rule. The token is #3a3b3c, matching dark mode; the user validated the themed light-mode conversation on the local server.

items.title: Theme and frontend verification gate
steps: Repeat the visual check in a custom chat theme when available.
items.expected: Theme styling remains legible, and every command exits successfully with no errors caused by this work.
items.evidence: 2026-08-26: After the cascade correction, npm --prefix frontend run typecheck and npm --prefix frontend run build passed. npm --prefix frontend run lint completed with six pre-existing warnings in AuthContext, ThemeContext, MessageQuoteStrip, PostDetailPage, and PostPhotoCommentsPage. The local Vite server returned HTTP 200.
items.notes: User-validated custom-theme browser check; frontend gates completed successfully.
